cap.description: Clamps the per-count product ("(Max +M)"). Absent = uncapped. schema v113

delta.description: Additive shift on the base attempt count: +N "additional/more", -N "fewer". 0 when only `set` applies. schema v113

per.description: When set, delta is scaled by the count of per_who's cards in per_zone matching this filter ("1 additional Breakout roll for each Skill Requirement card they have in play"). Absent = flat delta. schema v113

per_divisor.description: Integer divisor on the per-count before scaling. schema v113

per_excludes_self.description: Exclude the source card from the per count. Absent = false. schema v113

per_who.description: Whose board/pile the per count reads. Absent = SELF. schema v113

per_zone.description: Which zone the per count reads. Absent = IN_PLAY. schema v113

set.description: Absolute override of the base attempt count ("gets N Breakout rolls"); absent = shift the base by delta only. When several effects set, the smallest wins. schema v113

who.description: Affected side from the owner's POV: SELF = the owner's own breakout attempts, OPP = the owner's opponent's. Absent = SELF. schema v113

GrantBreakoutBonus.description: Grant a timed '+delta to breakout rolls until the end of the turn' bonus, swept at the next turn start; survives the source card leaving play. who (default SELF, Mailman) names whose rolls: OPP = 'your opponent's breakout rolls are -N' (Why So Serious?!?).

cap.description: Clamps the per-count product ("(Max +M)"); the per-scaled bonus never exceeds cap. Absent = uncapped. schema v112

either.description: Symmetric: the modifier applies to whoever rolls, from either board ("if either player rolls <S> for their roll, their roll is +/-N"). Absent = false. schema v107

per.description: When set, delta is scaled by the count of per_who's cards in per_zone matching this filter ("for each Stop they have in play"). Absent = flat delta. schema v112

per_divisor.description: Integer divisor on the per-count before scaling (count = floor(matches / per_divisor)). schema v112

per_excludes_self.description: Exclude the source card from the per count ("for each other <X> you have in play"). Absent = false. schema v112

per_who.description: Whose board/pile the per count reads. Absent = SELF. schema v112

per_zone.description: Which zone the per count reads. Absent = IN_PLAY. schema v112

per_excludes_self.description: Exclude the source card (the one carrying this buff) from the per count, for a "for each other <X> you have in play" buff. Absent = false. Only meaningful with per over the owner's own board.

from_crowd.description: Count is the Crowd Meter plus `n` (a signed offset), clamped to `cap` — "draw cards equal to the Crowd Meter +1 (Max +5)". Mutually exclusive with `per`. Absent = false. schema v108

cap.description: Clamps the per_crowd delta ("Max +N"). Absent = uncapped; ignored when per_crowd is false. schema v118

either.description: Symmetric: the modifier applies to whoever rolls, from either board ("if either player rolls <S> for their roll, their roll is +/-N"). Absent = false. schema v107

per_crowd.description: Dynamic delta = the Crowd Meter (clamped to cap), not the flat delta — "your <S> is + the Crowd Meter (Max +N) during your turn roll". Turn-roll-scoped, so it never leaks into effective_stats. Absent = false. schema v118

who.description: Whose turn roll this modifies, from the owner's POV. Absent = SelfSide (the owner's own roll, "your <S> is +N during turn rolls"); Opp = the owner's opponent's ("your opponent's <S> is -N during their turn rolls"). turn_roll_bonus sums a roller's own SelfSide mods with their opponent's Opp mods. schema v122

cap.description: Clamps the per-count product ("(Max +M)"); the per-scaled bonus never exceeds cap. Null = uncapped. schema v106

per_crowd.description: Dynamic delta = the live Crowd Meter (clamped to cap), a SECOND crowd-meter addend on top of the one the finish math already folds into every roll — "Your Finish roll is + the Crowd Meter (Max +N)". Mutually exclusive with the flat delta / per count. Absent = false. schema v123

per_excludes_self.description: Exclude the source card from the per count ("for each other <X> you have in play"). Absent = false. schema v106

MillDeck.description: Move count card(s) from the `from` end of who's DECK to their discard pile (plain mill, no flip semantics).

RollDraw.description: One-shot roll-conditional draw: "if your [opponent's] next turn roll is <S>, draw N". `who` is which side's next turn roll to WATCH (SelfSide = your own, Opp = your opponent's); the effect owner draws `count` if that roll resolves to `skill`. Fires-or-fizzles on that one turn roll and is consumed. schema v109

NextRollSkillBonus.description: One-turn skill-gated turn-roll bonus: "+N to <S>, <S> during your next turn roll" / "if your [opponent's] next turn roll is <S>, it is +N". `who` is whose roll it modifies (SelfSide = your own, Opp = your opponent's); `delta` applies to that side's IMMEDIATELY-next turn roll if it comes up one of `skills`, then the whole pending queue is drained (one-turn window, a non-match fizzles). Distinct from ModifyRoll{on_skill}, which waits indefinitely for one skill. schema v110

MultiTurnRollBonus.description: Multi-turn turn-roll bonus: "your [opponent's] next N turn rolls are +/-N". `who` is whose rolls it modifies (SelfSide = your own, Opp = your opponent's); `delta` applies to each of that side's next `rolls` turn rolls, decrementing once per roll-off until exhausted. Skill-agnostic and self-expiring (unlike the standing TurnRollBonus). schema v111

DrewThisTurn.description: who has drawn at least at_least cards this turn ('if you drew 1 or more cards this turn, …'). Reads PlayerState.drew_this_turn.

LostTurnRollsInARow.description: who has lost at least at_least turn rolls in a row ('if you lose 2 Turn Rolls in a row, …', Me Against the World). Reads PlayerState.turn_losses_in_a_row.

on_skill.description: When set (with when=NEXT), a skill-keyed pending mod: waits until who next rolls this skill for their turn roll, applies delta to that roll, then is consumed. Null = plain next/this mod.

attempts.description: 1-based breakout-roll ordinals this fires on ('their 1st or 2nd breakout roll' -> [1,2]). Empty = every roll.

from_hand.description: Dispatch this OnHit from the owner's HAND ('reveal this card from your hand when your opponent hits X' — The Mailman Always Delivers), not the board. Defaults false.

OnDraw.description: Fires right after who draws one or more cards (run_on_draw at the draw chokepoint). Used by a WhileInDiscard recur gated on DrewThisTurn (The Gobstopper).

Reveal.description: who reveals count card(s) from their own hand to the opponent (fog-of-war); the revealing player chooses which via a 'reveal' decision. No zone change.

whole_hand.description: Reveal EVERY card in who's hand at once, ignoring count and the per-card choice ('Reveal your hand to your opponent'). Defaults false.

RedirectBoardEffect.description: The per-player halves of an "each player …" board effect (Apocalypse, Rejected!, Derailed), wrapped so a competitor with a matching RedirectAuthority (Emo Mam) may choose which players they affect; absent one, every half applies (a plain each-player effect). schema v135

RedirectAuthority.description: A passive gimmick marker (Emo Mam): the competitor may choose who the board effect of a resolving card named in `groups` affects. Read by RedirectBoardEffect; never executes on its own. schema v135

then_bury.description: After shuffling, bury as many cards from HAND as were shuffled ('… then bury the same number of cards from your hand', Double Leg Death Lock). Defaults false.
